1use std::collections::HashMap;
2use std::fs::File;
3use std::io::Read;
4use std::path::Path;
5
6use flate2::read::MultiGzDecoder;
7
8use crate::error::{Result, TrxError};
9
10#[derive(Debug)]
11pub(super) struct MatRecord {
12    pub rows: usize,
13    pub cols: usize,
14    pub ty: u32,
15    pub payload: Vec<u8>,
16}
17
18pub(super) fn read_tt_mat_records(path: &Path) -> Result<HashMap<String, MatRecord>> {
19    let mut file = File::open(path)?;
20    let mut decoder = MultiGzDecoder::new(&mut file);
21    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
22    decoder.read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
23    parse_mat_records(&bytes)
24}
25
26fn parse_mat_records(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<HashMap<String, MatRecord>> {
27    let mut records = HashMap::new();
28    let mut cursor = 0usize;
29    while cursor < bytes.len() {
30        if cursor + 20 > bytes.len() {
31            return Err(TrxError::Format("truncated TT MAT record header".into()));
32        }
33        let ty = read_u32(bytes, &mut cursor)?;
34        let rows = read_u32(bytes, &mut cursor)? as usize;
35        let cols = read_u32(bytes, &mut cursor)? as usize;
36        let _imagf = read_u32(bytes, &mut cursor)?;
37        let namelen = read_u32(bytes, &mut cursor)? as usize;
38
39        let elem_size = mat_elem_size(ty)?;
40        if namelen == 0 {
41            return Err(TrxError::Format(
42                "TT MAT record has zero-length name".into(),
43            ));
44        }
45        if cursor + namelen > bytes.len() {
46            return Err(TrxError::Format("truncated TT MAT record name".into()));
47        }
48        let name_bytes = &bytes[cursor..cursor + namelen];
49        cursor += namelen;
50        let name = name_bytes
51            .split(|byte| *byte == 0)
52            .next()
53            .unwrap_or_default();
54        let name = std::str::from_utf8(name)
55            .map_err(|_| TrxError::Format("TT MAT record name is not valid UTF-8".into()))?
56            .to_string();
57
58        let payload_len = rows
59            .checked_mul(cols)
60            .and_then(|size| size.checked_mul(elem_size))
61            .ok_or_else(|| TrxError::Format(format!("TT MAT record '{name}' is too large")))?;
62        if cursor + payload_len > bytes.len() {
63            return Err(TrxError::Format(format!(
64                "truncated TT MAT payload for '{name}'"
65            )));
66        }
67        let payload = bytes[cursor..cursor + payload_len].to_vec();
68        cursor += payload_len;
69
70        records.insert(
71            name,
72            MatRecord {
73                rows,
74                cols,
75                ty,
76                payload,
77            },
78        );
79    }
80    Ok(records)
81}
82
83fn mat_elem_size(ty: u32) -> Result<usize> {
84    match ty {
85        0 => Ok(8),
86        10 => Ok(4),
87        20 => Ok(4),
88        30 | 40 => Ok(2),
89        50 => Ok(1),
90        60 => Ok(8),
91        other => Err(TrxError::Format(format!(
92            "unsupported TT MAT type code {other}"
93        ))),
94    }
95}
96
97fn read_u32(bytes: &[u8], cursor: &mut usize) -> Result<u32> {
98    let end = *cursor + 4;
99    let chunk = bytes
100        .get(*cursor..end)
101        .ok_or_else(|| TrxError::Format("truncated TT MAT integer".into()))?;
102    *cursor = end;
103    Ok(u32::from_le_bytes(chunk.try_into().unwrap()))
104}
